translationRepairs: Later he and Tuan went together to see their uncle by marriage, Minister of Education Yuan Can. Can told Tuan, "Orphaned so young, yet he has come to this — renown and high office will surely be his."
Later he and Tuan went together to see their collateral uncle, Minister of Education Yuan Can. Can told Tuan, "Orphaned so young, yet he has come to this — renown and high office will surely be his."
s0009 從叔司徒粲 names Yuan Can as a paternal collateral uncle (same surname, junior uncle), not an uncle by marriage; the proposed idiomatic correctly replaces that kinship error.
He was enfeoffed with the posthumous title Duke of Reverent Uprightness.
He was granted by patent the posthumous title Duke of Reverent Uprightness.
s0124 册諡曰穆正公 records conferral of a posthumous title by patent; 册諡 is not enfeoffment, so replacing 'enfeoffed' with 'granted by patent' is accurate.
Ang had been orphaned young and was raised by Tuan; he therefore instituted full mourning dress.
Ang had been orphaned young and was raised by Tuan; he therefore put on one-year mourning dress.
s0018 乃制棊服 uses 棊/期服, the one-year mourning grade; 'full mourning' overstates the grade, and the proposed literal restores the correct term.
